methodology: Editorial review of every exercise display name, catalog label and UI resource in all five locales, including InfoPlist.xcstrings.
Web research used local exercise atlases, trainers, academic materials and equipment manufacturers. Names were compared by movement, posture and equipment rather than literal English word order.
ATTESTED means the name is present in the cited page (ignoring capitalization); ATTESTED_INDEXED means indexed source text supports it but full-page access was unavailable or not completed.
TERM_FAMILY means source vocabulary or a corresponding movement is supported; the complete edited UI wording, variant qualifier or plural is an editorial adaptation, not an exact quote.
UNCONFIRMED means no sufficient per-form web evidence is recorded. It does not mean the exercise is invalid. Such names remain an editorial decision, not a verified local naming standard.
No native-speaker certification or exhaustive independent confirmation of all 625 forms is claimed. Sparse-source descriptive variants remain explicitly unconfirmed.
Canonical names, seeds, model identity, video lookup keys and stored history are unchanged. No video replacement or integration change was made.
